reason: I'm a deal hunter who compares every AI tool on price per seat and switches for free tiers — the first five humans are free, so my team stays on the free tier and I never convert to $30 a seat.
objection: Handing every agent's credentials, hooks, and sessions to one local daemon from an unproven vendor is a single point of failure I'd have to trust before I'd pay.
would_change_my_mind: If the daemon were open source and self-auditable, or free forever for small teams.
